shots.brief: Beats 1-4: one finished output per half-beat (8 hard cuts, full-bleed or centered on black, mixed: posters, ticket, zine, specimen, motion frame). Beats 5-6: quarter-beat strobe (8 cuts). Beats 7-8: black, 'rundeer' wordmark in Neue Montreal Bold, white, slams in on frame 90, tiny mono subline 'node-based workbench for AI image & video'.
Start tight on the final preview node showing a poster (fills ~70% of frame), ease-in-out pull back until the whole graph fits with margin. Last 20 frames hold wide.

captions.title: AI image & video, wired as nodes.

shots.brief: Texture -> poster pairs: poster_tex_N_01.png (black/white AI letterforms) slams in, then on the half-beat the finished poster_0NN.png wipes over it (hard vertical wipe or smear-ish). 3 pairs, 30 frames each. Pair index N matches poster_0NN (tex 0 -> poster_000 etc.).

captions.title:
AI draws the letters.
The graph does the rest.
captions.line: SMEAR · BLUR · GRAIN · DITHER · DUOTONE · LAYOUT

shots.brief: Rapid-fire through all 30 posters, accelerating: starts at 1 poster per 6 frames, ends at 1 per 2 frames. Posters centered at full height on black with a big mono counter (001..030) that ticks with each cut. Optionally slight scale punch per cut.
Wall of all 30 posters (+ textures interleaved as a second layer or a 10x6 grid mixing both) assembling fast then a slow zoom-out revealing the whole wall. End wide.

captions.title:
30 posters.
1 graph. 0 hand edits.
captions.line: EVERY RUN ROLLS NEW WORDS, PALETTES, SMEARS & LAYOUTS

shots.brief: Dolly left-to-right along the main spine (top rows, node y ~0..520) from the input column to the Tickets preview/export, zoom so node bodies and thumbnails read.
Tickets slam onto black on beats, stacking/fanning with slight rotation like a pile of printed tickets. Use all tickets available.

captions.title: Two halftone plates.
captions.line: MISREGISTERED ON PURPOSE, LIKE REAL RISO

shots.brief: AI photo -> printed page: zine_photo_N_01.png shown, then the two ink plates 'print' over it (split the finished page_00N.png into its two ink colors if feasible, or reveal the page with a halftone-dot transition), ending on the zine page(s) side by side.

captions.title: AI photo in. Printed page out.
captions.line: HALFTONE · INK COVERAGE · PAPER GRAIN · MULTIPLY

shots.brief: Specimen sheet builds: header first, then the 9 cells pop in one per half-beat (crop cells from sheet_00N.png), then quick cut through the other sheets.

captions.title: 1 glyph. 9 cuts.
captions.line: EACH CELL ONE STEP FURTHER ALONG THE WAVE

captions.title: 7 waves. 36 frames.
captions.line: SWAY · SCROLL · BREATH · SHIMMER · ORBIT · PULSE

shots.brief: The 3 motion clips (12fps, 36 frames, loop) play: first one big centered, then on a beat the other two slide in for a 3-up, all looping in sync.

Frames 0-75: giant wall of everything (posters, textures, tickets, zine pages, specimen sheets, motion frames) zooming out fast with parallax. Frames 75-135: cut to black, 'rundeer' wordmark centered (same as cold_open end), subline 'node-based. AI-native. built for artists.' in mono, hold.

assets.promo_runs: .rundeer/outputs/promo_runs/<graph>/ (fresh outputs rendered by agent A during capture, may appear later)
